title: Qwik City before 1.20.3 (@builder.io/qwik-city) and @qwik.dev/router before 2.0.0-rc.4 contain an improperly…
description: Qwik City versions before 1.20.3 and @qwik.dev/router versions before 2.0.0-rc.4 have a vulnerability in the formToObj function that allows unauthenticated attackers to overwrite built-in function properties by sending specially crafted form POST requests. This causes the Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call method to be broken process-wide until the server is restarted.
